description: One record per intent. The registry is versioned only, never silently rewritten. Source: PDT v1.2 §7.2, plus the 2026-11-23 bidirectional intent-category decision (one intent may belong to multiple categories with one primary category).

category_assignments.description: Every category this intent belongs to, each with the reason and evidence for that assignment. Secondary categories are shown in drill-downs but never summed into totals.

evidence.description: Quote or cluster that justifies this assignment

category_ids.description: All categories this intent belongs to, including the primary one. An intent may belong to several categories; counting and roll-ups use the primary category only, so nothing is double-counted.

definition.description: Actionable definition (annotators and Jev use the same text)

evidence_sources.description: Evidence count split by source, never a single pooled total

exclusion_criteria.description: What does not count, with at least 1 boundary example

inclusion_criteria.description: What counts, with at least 1 boundary example

intent_id.description: Globally unique intent number, e.g. INT-001

name.description: One-line name, shared by annotators and Jev

primary_category_id.description: The one primary category of this intent. Required: exactly one primary category per intent. Roll-ups, totals and category-level trends use the primary category only.

representative_quotes.description: At least 3 original excerpts + links; add more as evidence accumulates

validation_status.description: Failed intents are downgraded, split or returned to the candidate pool, with the reason recorded

version.description: Definition change bumps the minor version; registry-structure change bumps the major version

title: Intent Registry Entry
